uncertainties.note: Speakers in this confrontation (Gain, an unnamed 'king'-seeking captor, Asuham) are not tagged in the source table. Vocative names ('Gain!', 'Asuham!') are kept literal from the source; no additional speaker identity was invented.
Source honorific -dono on Cynthia (Shinshia-dono) rendered as 'Lady Cynthia'. No prior project convention for this honorific was found in the glossary; flagging for orchestrator confirmation.

'Gekko' (the Eureka Seven ship, locked per meeting_terms_015.json) appears as an allied mothership in this King Gainer battle (resource 6290). Translated literally per the lock; flagging the crossover roster for confirmation since this scene was not independently verified against a mission unit list.
Referent of source 'yatsu' ('that thing/guy') is ambiguous between the Overdevil machine and its pilot; rendered with a neutral 'that thing' rather than assigning gender or identity.
Liman Megalopolis is carried over from encyclopedia_021_b.json/encyclopedia_022.json, which themselves flag the romanization as unverified (no English source found).

validation.commands: Every <op()>/<sp(20)>/<ab(n)>/<ed()> in each row matches the source's presence, values and order exactly, including rows lacking <op()> or <ed()> where the source omits them.
validation.fit: All rows drafted in full; longest visible strings are under 110 characters. No row was shortened for space.
validation.ascii: Straight quotes and ASCII ellipsis (...) used throughout; lowercase j/q avoided where a natural synonym existed ('just'->'exactly'/'only', 'question'->'issue'); locked terms Overdevil/Gekkostate/etc. are exempt where unavoidable.
validation.glossary: Names/terms checked against terms_028.json, character_names_021.json, mission_terms_019.json, meeting_terms_015.json, glossary.json and encyclopedia_022.json. New coinages (Ginga, Overfreeze, Oversense) recorded in batch_09615_glossary_proposals.json.
validation.meaning_review: Independently meaning-reviewed against tools/dialogue_corpus.py source (rows 9600-9709, 110 examined) and cross-checked for term/voice consistency against batch_09695.json/batch_09775.json. One fix applied (dialogue_09649: dropped an invented claim of personal acquaintance not in the source). All 80 rows set to meaning_reviewed; see review_09615.json.
